name: 492. HuggingFace on a configured base URL asks the model hub there, fetches a speech audio URL on its origin and refuses one on a loopback host (huggingface hub host)
description: Local fixture regression for TXE-7117 (and the HuggingFace rows TXE-7090 could not have), no live provider calls. Start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs and an isolated gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, whose huggingface provider has the fixture as base URL, and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. Before an inference call HuggingFace looks its model up at the model hub (/api/models/<model>). That lookup went to https://huggingface.co whatever the base URL was, so an offline gateway was refused there and no HuggingFace request could reach a fixture. It now goes to <base_url>/api/models when the base URL is not the default router. The fixture answers the lookup (fal-ai serves the model as text-to-speech), fal-ai's speech call, and the audio file the answer names. 492.2 asks for speech with the model fixture/speech-origin, whose audio URL is on the fixture's own origin: the audio comes back. 492.3 asks with fixture/speech-loopback, whose audio URL names the same fixture by the host name localhost, another origin on loopback: the gateway refuses it. 492.4 reads the counters: the audio was asked for once at 127.0.0.1 and never at localhost. The lookups are counted too, at most once per model, because the gateway caches them; that they reach the fixture is shown by 492.2 and 492.3 getting past the lookup on an offline gateway at all.
